annotation.title_clean: სწავლა-სწავლების პროცესში ხელოვნური ინტელექტისა (AI) და მონაცემების გამოყენების ეთიკური გზამკვლევი განათლების სპეციალისტებისთვის
annotation.title_en: Ethical guidelines on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and data in teaching and learning for educators
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (Georgian edition published by EU Delegation to Georgia / Education and Research Center)
annotation.venue: Publications Office of the European Union / Tbilisi
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Georgian edition of the European Commission's ethical guidelines for educators on using AI and data in teaching and learning. It sets ethical considerations and seven trustworthy-AI requirements, guiding questions, school case scenarios, planning steps and educator competence indicators. No embodied AI content beyond a glossary entry on educational robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four ethical considerations: human agency, fairness, humanity, justified choice
Seven AI HLEG requirements turned into guiding questions for educators
Schools must comply with GDPR and conduct data protection impact assessments
Recommends piloting, monitoring and provider collaboration before school-wide AI adoption
Competence indicators for teachers based on DigCompEdu
